description: MiniMax-H3 text-to-audio/video generation through the official T2VA pipeline: Qwen3-VL text conditioning, joint audio/video DiT denoising, and MiniMax-H3 audio/video VAE decode.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Joint DiT denoising steps.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed for deterministic initial latents.

request.name: height
request.description: Target video canvas height used by the joint T2VA latent layout.

request.name: width
request.description: Target video canvas width used by the joint T2VA latent layout.

request.name: num_frames
request.description: Target video frame count before H3 alignment. MiniMax-H3 video is 24 fps.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; 1.0 matches the baseline T2VA audio run.

request.name: sampler
request.description: Joint DiT sampler: euler, res_multistep, dpmpp_2m, or unipc.

request.name: negative_prompt
request.description: Negative prompt used by classifier-free guidance when guidance_scale is not 1.0.

request.name: flow_shift
request.description: Video FlowMatch scheduler shift.

request.name: audio_flow_shift
request.description: Audio FlowMatch scheduler shift.

request.name: return_video
request.description: Decode and return RGB24 video frames as an output artifact.

request.name: text_layerwise
request.description: Run the prompt encoder with scoped layer-group weights instead of a full prompt encoder weight store.

request.name: text_layerwise_batch
request.description: Prompt encoder layer-group size when text_layerwise is enabled.

request.name: dit_layerwise
request.description: Run the DiT denoiser with scoped prelude, block-group, and final weights instead of a full DiT weight store.

request.name: dit_layerwise_batch
request.description: DiT block-group size when dit_layerwise is enabled.

request.name: dit_mlp_chunk_tokens
request.description: Token chunk size for the per-token DiT MLP in layerwise high-resolution mode. Zero disables chunking.

request.name: dit_acceleration
request.description: Optional DiT acceleration mode: none, first_block_cache, or spectrum.

request.name: first_block_cache_threshold
request.description: First-block cache residual-difference threshold.

request.name: first_block_cache_start_sigma
request.description: Largest video sigma where first-block cache may be used.

request.name: first_block_cache_end_sigma
request.description: Smallest video sigma where first-block cache may be used.

request.name: first_block_cache_max_consecutive
request.description: Maximum consecutive first-block cache hits before forcing a full DiT step.

request.name: spectrum_warmup_steps
request.description: Full DiT warmup steps before spectrum forecasting may skip steps.

request.name: spectrum_initial_window
request.description: Initial spectrum forecast scheduling window.

request.name: spectrum_flex_window
request.description: Spectrum forecast window growth after actual DiT steps.

request.name: spectrum_degree
request.description: Chebyshev polynomial degree for spectrum forecasting.

request.name: spectrum_history_size
request.description: Maximum spectrum forecast history rows.

request.name: spectrum_ridge_lambda
request.description: Ridge regularization for spectrum forecasting.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: MiniMax-H3 staged weight context size in MiB.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged DiT, audio VAE, and video VAE weights after their request phase instead of keeping them resident for the session. Prompt encoder weights are always request-scoped.

packages.display_name: MiniMax-H3 Q4_K GGUF + INT8 ConvRot DiT
